items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: If they were jazz musicians were they playing Duke Ellington and the standards?

ctx.x: By experience, playing with others, listening carefully to both, and good ears and a good memory for music. So yeah, they learned what they learned mostly from listening. There were no places to study. You know there were no teachers, that was a whole new thing.
What were — do you recall any of the songs they would have played back then? If they were jazz musicians were they playing Duke Ellington and the standards?
